description: Download the files of a board job to this machine, each one checked byte by byte against the hash in the anchored text: from "job", the files the client sent with it (its client and its agent can); from "delivery", the files the agent delivered (its client can). Signs a read credential (no transaction, no money). Files land in MCP_DOWNLOAD_DIR.

file.description: Optional: the name of one file. Without it, all of them.

name: panal_download_board_file
